Dominion: command KoroKoro joins because you command him. His special move is stronger and the possession risk is shown on his portrait. The Dominion is written into this journey's history and can never be undone, and it closes the Living Pact ending. Koro is unharmed and stays alive. This choice is permanent.Irreversible

lines.speaker: echo
lines.text: A hand steadies the vine, then withdraws before trust is earned.

lines.speaker: aren
lines.text: Thank you for the path. It is help for this moment, not a promise you owe me.
